senses.gloss: m.(b. h. אַפִּרְ׳; = על פריון, פּוּר, פָּרַר; cmp. אפיפיירות, פיפיורא, פּוּרְיָא &c.) [on a frame,] frame and hangings of a palanquin, litter of parade, esp. for a bride in the wedding procession.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:14">Sot. IX, 14</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49a">49ᵃ</cite>); Tosef. ib. XV, 9.—

<cite ref="Sotah 12a:13">Sot. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>הושיבה בא׳</he> (<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 43:1">Pesik. R. s. 43</cite> <he>בפוריא</he>), a. e. he placed her in the litter, arranged a wedding procession for her.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>, end, <he>לישב בא׳</he> to take her seat in the litter (for the wedding procession); a. e.
